## What's changed

- Updated custom Tube TV channels to play every selected movie and episode once before any item repeats, while keeping the lineup randomized between cycles.
- Preserved the current Tube TV schedule when local-library scans discover changes, preventing active channels from being unexpectedly rebuilt or advanced.
- Kept active channel streams available during guide maintenance so library updates do not interrupt playback already in progress.
- Increased the live HLS window and idle tolerance to help players recover cleanly from brief network, decoder, or guide-refresh pauses instead of skipping early to the next program.
